source.originalTitle: Cuyahoga County Centennial Parade Watchers CP04200 - DPLA - 0ace80f9f96f986273f5c7260e5a1e0a.jpg
source.description: A crowd watches the Cuyahoga County centennial parade as it passes through Public Square. Parade watchers are in the northeast quadrant of Public Square and can be seen standing on top of streetcars and on park benches. The buildings around the square are festooned with bunting and banners. Prominent in the background are the Cuyahoga building (left) and adjacent Williamson building (right), both of which were demolished in 1982 to make way for the Sohio (later BP America) building at 200 Public Square. Buildings along Euclid Avenue can be seen to the right of the Williamson building.

scenes.anomaly: Zeitreisender: junger Mann im dunklen Anzug mit modernen weißen Sneakers
scenes.description: Eine dichte Menschenmenge verfolgt den Jahrhundert-Umzug des Cuyahoga County auf dem Public Square. Zuschauer stehen auf dem Gehsteig, auf Bänken und sogar auf den Dächern der Straßenbahnen.
hints: Der Anachronismus ist eine Person, kein Gegenstand.
Er steht im mittleren Bildbereich rechts der Mitte, hinter einem Kind.
Der junge Mann im dunklen Anzug links neben der Frau mit dunklem Kleid und Hut trägt moderne weiße Sneakers.

scenes.title: Marktszene in Tepec

source.originalTitle: Market scene including restaurant and street, Tepec, Mexico, ca.1900 (CHS-618).jpg
source.description:
Market scene including restaurant and street, Tepec, Mexico, ca.1900
Photograph of market scene including restaurant and street, Tepec, Mexico, ca.1900. In the foreground at right, a large dirt road is visible. The goods on the street have been unloaded from the burro. To the right of the items on the street, a single large pole can be seen. A dozen or more people, most wearing sombreros and ponchos, are standing on the sidewalk, the dirt road, or sitting in the open air restaurant. The buildings have tile roofs.
